conditions_sentence: Measured on one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB with bfloat16 model weights, batch size 1, greedy decoding, and each arm's registered evaluation path; no batched-throughput claim is made.
dense_timing_note: For Arms B/C/D, total time is the registered Transformers greedy generate path; prefill is a synchronized one-token generate reference and decode-side time is the nonnegative difference.

hardware.gpu_exclusivity_note: At most the current evaluator process was visible to nvidia-smi.

recurrent_timing_note: For Arms A/E, total is the actual forced-depth call; prefill is a synchronized one-loop reference and decode-side is the nonnegative difference.
scope: single hardware configuration, batch size 1, registered evaluation paths
